assets.title: Dim's Arboretum
assets.author: Dim
notes: Textured mature conifer/tree, vegetation, logs and props. Blender source pack from 2010; inspect packed texture links and convert to glTF. Attribute Dim, source and CC-BY-3.0; identify modifications.
ZIP CRC verified and safely extracted; content is data only and has not been executed.

Read-only Blender DNA inspection: 65 meshes, including Fir (201 vertices / 96 faces), FirSmall (87 / 41), Beech (151 / 101), woodpile and vegetation. These are low-detail branch-card assets suited to mid/far forest; conversion and texture adaptation remain.

assets.title: JKM's tree set
assets.author: Julius Krischan Makowka (JKM / Julius)
notes: Game-oriented mature pine and deciduous trees with alternate skins, originally made for Quake 3. Selected CC-BY-SA-3.0 from offered license choices. Preserve attribution and share-alike for asset derivatives; check transparency, texture resolution and materials. Useful candidate for mid/far forest, not claimed modern AAA quality.
ZIP CRC verified and safely extracted; content is data only and has not been executed.

OBJ inspection: full-size pine 171 vertices / 113 triangles; five OBJ variants total. Source OBJ files reference missing MTL files. All leaf TGA and bark JPG textures are present; material bindings must be repaired before textured import. Appropriate mainly for distant trees/LOD.

assets.title: Birch Tree
assets.author: AnyRPG; derivative of geekygnome Low Poly Tree
notes: Source page states 1294 vertices / 1776 triangles. Blender source with birch bark; inspect leaf alpha and convert to glTF. Semi-realistic stylized foliage, not a scanned tree.

Read-only Blender DNA inspection confirms 3 meshes: a ground plane and two 647-vertex, 462-polygon tree meshes. Page aggregate: 1294 vertices / 1776 triangles. Blender 2.81 source; convert and verify leaf transparency.

Read-only Blender DNA inspection confirms 18 meshes and a bAction named Sawing. No animation playback or Blender export has been performed. Source data is Blender 2.71.

assets.title: Nobiax Modular Building Asset
assets.author: Yughues (Nobiax)
notes: Industrial walls, roof, door/window/pillar modules. Use structural pieces suitable to the period; exclude modern air-conditioning equipment. Check UVs and apply collected PBR materials where needed.

Archive contains 34 OBJ modules plus matching 34 FBX versions; OBJ estimated triangles range 12–154 per module. OBJ has no MTL binding; source TGA maps are present and decode correctly. Material assignment remains.
